"""Shared types and exceptions for Wordle."""
from enum import Enum
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import List


class Feedback(Enum):
    """Feedback for each letter in a guess."""
    HIT = "hit"        # Correct letter in correct position
    PRESENT = "present"  # Correct letter in wrong position  
    MISS = "miss"      # Letter not in target word


class GameStatus(Enum):
    """Current status of the game."""
    IN_PROGRESS = "in_progress"
    WON = "won"
    LOST = "lost"


@dataclass
class GuessResult:
    """Result of a single guess."""
    guess: str
    feedbacks: List[Feedback]
    

class InvalidGuessError(Exception):
    """Raised when a guess is not valid (not in dictionary, wrong length, etc)."""
    pass


class GameOverError(Exception):
    """Raised when trying to make a guess after the game has ended."""
    pass

    """Test scoring when guess exactly matches target."""

    assert len(result) == 5
    assert all(feedback == Feedback.HIT for feedback in result)

    """Test scoring when guess has no matching letters."""

    """Test scoring with mixed hit, present, and miss feedback."""

    """Test letter counting functionality."""

import pytest
from unittest.mock import MagicMock
from wordle.game import Game
from wordle.types import GameStatus, InvalidGuessError, GameOverError


def test_game_init():
    """Test game initialization."""
    game = Game("HELLO")
    status = game.get_status()
    assert status == GameStatus.IN_PROGRESS

    attempts = game.get_attempts_remaining()
    assert attempts == 6


def test_make_guess_valid():
    """Test making a valid guess."""
    game = Game("HELLO")
    result = game.make_guess("WORLD")

    assert result.guess == "WORLD"
    assert len(result.feedbacks) == 5

    attempts = game.get_attempts_remaining()
    assert attempts == 5


def test_make_guess_winning():
    """Test winning the game with correct guess."""
    game = Game("HELLO")
    result = game.make_guess("HELLO")

    assert result.guess == "HELLO"
    status = game.get_status()
    assert status == GameStatus.WON


def test_get_results():
    """Test getting all guess results."""
    game = Game("HELLO")
    game.make_guess("WORLD")
    game.make_guess("GREAT")

    results = game.get_results()
    assert len(results) == 2
    assert results[0].guess == "WORLD"
    assert results[1].guess == "GREAT"


def test_get_target_word():
    """Test getting target word after game over."""
    game = Game("HELLO")

    # Target should be None during game
    target = game.get_target_word()
    assert target is None

    # Win the game
    game.make_guess("HELLO")
    target = game.get_target_word()
    assert target == "HELLO"


def test_reset_game():
    """Test resetting the game."""
    game = Game("HELLO")
    game.make_guess("WORLD")

    game.reset("TESTS")
    status = game.get_status()
    assert status == GameStatus.IN_PROGRESS

    attempts = game.get_attempts_remaining()
    assert attempts == 6

    results = game.get_results()
    assert len(results) == 0


def test_game_over_after_six_attempts():
    """Test game over after maximum attempts."""
    game = Game("HELLO")

    # Make 6 wrong guesses
    for _ in range(6):
        game.make_guess("WRONG")

    status = game.get_status()
    assert status == GameStatus.LOST
